transcript: Here's how to loosen phlegm and mucus from your lungs and throat naturally, using one ancient plant. My friend, mucus does not leave when you force it. It leaves when the lungs feel safe enough to release. For hundreds of years, one plant has been used for this. Its name is moline. Moline does not dry you out. It does not chi-chi the throat. It gently coats the airways and helps the lungs let go of what's stuck. This is how it's traditionally used. Steep one teaspoon of dried mulin leaf in hot water for 10 minutes. Strain it well. The tiny hairs must be removed. Sip slowly while breathing through your nose. Within minutes, many people feel the chest soften, the throat clear, and breathing become deeper. This plant works because it calms inflammation and supports the natural cleansing of the lungs, not by force, but by balance. If mucus keeps returning, it is often a sign of stress, cold air, dairy, or a weakened breath. In the east, we clear the lungs by calming the nervous system first. Then the body releases on its own. Follow, and I will teach you how to heal without fighting your body.
